title: Artemis
author: Andy Weir
summary: On the first city on the Moon, a young smuggler takes on a lucrative sabotage job that turns out to be tied to a larger conspiracy. She has to use her wits and knowledge of the city to survive.
readIf: you like caper plots with lots of practical science and a brash, sarcastic narrator.
skipIf: you want the charm of the author's earlier books; the main voice is more abrasive, and the plot more routine.

pairings.reason: The author's first and more beloved novel, with a lone problem-solver and a brisker, funnier tone.
A fantasy heist about a clever criminal crew, with just as much patter and plotting.
Another lived-in solar-system story that mixes a noir mystery with big conspiracies.
